dates.source: Umm Al-Qura Calendar (ummulqura.org.sa), the official calendar of Saudi Arabia, read on 12 November 2026; UK moon-sighting predictions give 10 March for Eid. Research record: _implementation/research/ramadan/dates.json.
dates.note: Expected dates; confirm with your local moon sighting.

hadith.paraphrase: Aisha reports that the Prophet ﷺ told people to search for the Night of Qadr in the odd nights of the last ten nights of Ramadan.
Aisha reports that when the last ten nights began, the Prophet ﷺ would strive harder in worship, pray through the night and wake his family for prayer.
Abu Hurairah reports that the Prophet ﷺ said that whoever fasts Ramadan, or stands in prayer on the Night of Qadr, out of faith and hoping for Allah's reward, is forgiven their past sins.
